text:
Elena (Sales): quick warm handoff for Northpoint (NP-88). They signed a 6-week POC. Requirements: dedicated private deployment in us-east, SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, embeddings migration from their legacy vendor (~1.2M vectors), target peak 8rps. Procurement wants SOC2 summary and data deletion SLA. Exec sponsor is CISO Jane Park. cc @Rahul (CS)
Rahul (CS): thanks Elena 1 — I'll lead onboarding and be primary CS contact. Plan: 1) provision sandbox dedicated env 2) SSO metadata exchange 3) embedding migration runbook + dry-run 4) tech kickoff w/ eng/support 5) weekly health + feedback form. I'll draft a migration playbook.
Maya (CS): i'll own enablement + onboarding docs, run initial quality evals on migrated vectors, and prepare usage guidance for model configs. Suggest weekly 30m syncs and an exec check-in at week 3.
Owen (Support): opening infra ticket and preflight. Quick Q: do they require VPC peering or private link? Need to know to size networking and estimate Dedicated footprint.
onboard-bot: Ticket created: ONB-6001  assignee: support-onboarding  link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-6001
Priya (Eng): hi team 1. For embedding migration: what's vector dimensionality and whether they need incremental reindexing? Also confirm desired model family for embeddings (text-embedding-ada-like or higher-dim). Est. effort: migration tooling + validation ~4d (1 eng + 1 infra), dedicated build for private deployment ~3d. Will need sample dataset to run smoke tests.
Elena (Sales): attaching spec + contact: https://drive.redwood/northpoint/poc-spec.pdf. Vector dim = 1536, they want incremental reindex ability. Preferred embeddings model: redwood-embed-large. They want data deletion and audit logs in the contract. POC kickoff goal: next Tue morning. Procurement expects SOC2 summary now.
Rahul (CS): action items recap:
- Elena: share final PM/infra contacts + SSO metadata by EOD
- Owen: create ONB-6001 preflight with VPC vs private-link decision, due Fri
- Priya: scope migration tooling + dedicated build estimate, reply Fri EOD
- Maya: draft enablement + feedback capture form, share before kickoff
- Rahul: schedule kickoff Tue 9:30am ET, run renewal-risk watch and exec sync plan
Please update ONB-6001 with owners and blockers.
Owen (Support): will ping networking and attach checklist to ONB-6001. If private link required, will need 5 business days lead to coordinate infra.
Priya (Eng): noted. i'll post a small compatibility checklist in the ticket and what test data we need. Also: do they expect streaming responses or batch-only for embeddings?
Elena (Sales): embeddings only upsert/retrieval for POC. No streaming. They prefer batched upserts for speed.
Maya (CS): i'll include sample upsert curl and retrieval snippet in the enablement doc:
```
# upsert vectors
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/upsert" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"namespace":"northpoint-prod","vectors":[{"id":"doc1","values":[0.01,0.23,...],"metadata":{"source":"legacy"}}]}'
```
Rahul (CS): renewal-risk note: Northpoint is running side-by-side evals vs two other vendors. Procurement timeline could stretch POC to 10+ weeks. Flagging as medium-high risk; escalate to AM if procurement extends beyond 6 weeks.
Owen (Support): ack. i'll add risk tag in ONB-6001 and set reminder for day 30.
Priya (Eng): i'll estimate build + migration steps by Fri and include QA checklist. If they need KMS integration, add extra day for validation.
Elena (Sales): i'll share Jane Park's contact and SSO metadata now.
Rahul (CS): scheduling kickoff Tue 9:30am ET 1 1 — sending invites to Northpoint PM, Elena, Maya, Owen, Priya.
onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding kickoff scheduled Tue 09:30 ET  Calendar invite sent.
Maya (CS): great 1 i'll finalize the feedback capture form focused on onboarding pain points, vector quality, perf, and security checks. will post link after kickoff.
Elena (Sales): thanks everyone 1 closing handoff from sales side.
Rahul (CS): thanks team 1 please comment on ONB-6001 with any blockers or capacity asks.
